content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Chesapeake

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and formal project management education—no prior work experience necessary. This makes CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-stage professionals entering Chesapeake's growing project-driven sectors. Verify your education credentials before applying to PMI.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format condenses CAPM fundamentals into a structured schedule, allowing you to balance certification training with your current work and responsibilities in Chesapeake.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education hours, submit your formal application to the Project Management Institute and pay the associated exam fee. PMI will review and approve your candidacy before you schedule your certification exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources to reinforce key concepts and build your confidence. You'll take the computer-based CAPM exam at a Pearson Vue testing center, with results available immediately upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew every three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, conferences, and project experience to keep your certification active and demonstrate ongoing expertise to employers in your local job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
